headlines.title: These 3 Dividend Stocks Could Help Pay Retirement Bills Without Selling Shares
headlines.summary: Every share you sell to cover a retirement expense stops working for you forever, but there is a way to collect cash every quarter without shrinking your stake at all. Three dividend payers with ex-dates clustered within days of each other show exactly how that works.

headlines.title: Forget Flashy Stocks: These 3 Boring Businesses Have Decades of Dividend Payments
headlines.summary: Payroll still runs, factory bins still empty, and store coolers still need restocking whether the economy is booming or collapsing. Three companies built around that reality have quietly paid dividends through every crisis for over two decades, and their staying power comes down to one thing customers almost never do.

headlines.title: Why Fastenal (FAST) International Revenue Trends Deserve Your Attention
headlines.summary: Evaluate Fastenal's (FAST) reliance on international revenue to better understand the company's financial stability, growth prospects and potential stock price performance.

headlines.title: FAST- An Industrial Supplier Benefiting from Construction Boom
headlines.summary: Fastenal Co. (FAST) demonstrated strong financial performance in the third quarter of 2026, driven by a 15.5% increase in net sales to $2.5 billion alongside an acceleration in daily sales growth to 15.5% from 14.7% in the previous quarter, notes Ingrid Hendershot, editor of Hendershot Investments.

headlines.title: The Open Question Under Fastenal Stock's Price
headlines.summary: Fastenal (FAST) stock trades at 43.3 times earnings. The S&P 500 trades at 22.9. Shareholders are clearly paying a premium for a company that keeps growing. Management says its key account strategy mainly drove the latest quarter. These large customers generally carry lower gross margins. Fastenal has not yet shown that it can keep winning those accounts without wearing down the profit it makes on each sale.

description: Fastenal Company, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the wholesale distribution of industrial and construction supplies in the United States, Canada, Mexico, and internationally. It offers fasteners, and related industrial and construction supplies under the Fastenal name. The company's fastener products include threaded fasteners, bolts, nuts, screws, studs, and related washers that are used in manufactured products and construction projects, as well as in the maintenance and repair of machines. It offers miscellaneous supplies and hardware, including pins, machinery keys, concrete anchors, metal framing systems, wire ropes, strut products, rivets, and related accessories. The company serves the manufacturing market comprising original equipment manufacturers; maintenance, repair, and operations customers; non-residential construction market; farmers, truckers, railroads, mining companies, schools, and retail trades; and oil exploration, production, and refinement companies, as well as federal, state, and local governmental entities. Fastenal Company was founded in 1967 and is headquartered in Winona, Minnesota.
